shared_elements: a row of repeated small motifs across the width
upright slab-shaped field filled edge to edge with carved figures
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs carved in low relief and divided into stacked horizontal registers, each containing profile animals (including a bird and quadrupeds) and a row of repeated small motifs, which is the most specific point of contact. But the actual content differs fundamentally: A is a two-person offering scene with facing human figures, an offering stand and dense rows of small standardised script-like signs, while B has no human figures or writing and instead shows large, isolated, boldly schematic animals with a band of repeated arch-shaped forms, so the correspondence is of the generic sort any relief tradition could produce.
